title: Choose the visual world for Dzypher
question: The roll assigned the Palawan Sea Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Palawan Sea Chart
options.lineage: Hydrographic sea charts of the Philippine archipelago
options.thesis: Every product is charted as an archipelago: separate apps above, one shared backend beneath.
options.viewport: A framed chart sheet: headline and a working project planner on the left, an archipelago of app islands over one backend sea on the right; the course redraws as visitors pick what they need.
options.risk: Could read as a maritime or travel business if the copy goes timid, so chart language stays in the visuals and plain words stay in the copy.

raised.raise: Motion is growth along a stroke: contours and the plotted course draw themselves in, and nothing fades up.
Every app on a chart wears the same fixed name plate: name, platform, one-line job.
Tonal discipline: every tint is a screen of the same few inks, with no gradients and no soft shadows.
Input is first-class: the enquiry is a working control in the first viewport, and its result prints as chart text, not chrome.
Strict planes: linework below, lettering knocked out above it, controls on their own top plane.
Every quantity is measured and registered: real counts in tabular figures, never adjectives.

options.label: Interchange Map
options.lineage: Manila LRT/MRT line diagrams and station signage
options.thesis: Each app is a transit line, and every line meets at one interchange: the backend they share.
options.viewport: A wall-sized line diagram with Mobile, Web, and Admin lines converging on one interchange, the headline on a station sign, and a route planner as the action.
options.risk: Transit diagrams are a familiar device for roadmaps and tech sites; this is where many runs in this category land.

options.label: Secession Review Page
options.thesis: Folk-flower ornament grows in from the margins and leaves a clearing for the offer.
options.viewport: Ornamental border growing toward a central clearing that holds the headline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: none of Dzypher's audiences read Secession ornament, and the border crowds out the offer.
options.kept: Motion as growth along a stroke.
options.risk: Reads as a cultural journal, not a software studio.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Each app becomes a mascot with a name plate and a one-line personality.
options.viewport: A ranked roster of app mascots across a pastel grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: invented mascots would undercut trust with offices and overseas clients.
options.kept: One fixed name plate per item.
options.risk: Cute enough to lose the institutional buyers.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.thesis: Case studies open as windows on a dithered black-and-white desktop.
options.viewport: Overlapping windows on a dithered desktop, one per service.
options.case: Fuses poorly: retro chrome contradicts the request for a modern design and hides real screenshots.
options.kept: Every tint is a screen of the same inks.
options.risk: Nostalgia piece rather than a studio.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The studio answers in a live terminal transcript.
options.viewport: An 80-column transcript where typed commands reveal services.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an engineer's tool speaks past the founders, shops, and offices hiring Dzypher.
options.kept: The enquiry is a first-class input.
options.risk: Near-black with one neon accent, the most common tech look.

options.label: Multiplane Dawn
options.thesis: Painted Palawan planes drift past as the camera sinks toward the studio.
options.viewport: Layered painted scenery with the headline on the nearest cel.
options.case: Fuses poorly: needs painted scenery that does not exist, and the parallax buries the offer.
options.kept: Strict planes for lettering and controls.

options.label: Blacksmith Forge
options.thesis: Each project is a billet hammered into shape, blow by measured blow.
options.viewport: A glowing billet lengthening under the hammer beside the headline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: shaping raw material repeats the retired rough-ideas story and reads industrial, not software.
options.kept: Every quantity is measured and registered.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern studio landing page at full craft: statement headline, device mockups, services, case studies, process, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, subcopy, and the primary action on the left; a phone and a browser window showing real work on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other studios by design.
